summary: The ServiceProfileHistory is a part of the HSPnet application, primarily designed to handle and display historical data related to service profiles. It includes functionalities for data selection, management, and formatting, which are embedded within the application’s user interface components.
purpose: The purpose of the ServiceProfileHistory is to track and display historical actions and data changes related to service profiles within the HSPnet system, providing insights and details regarding user interactions and modifications over time.

fields.name: ActionDate

fields.name: ByUserID

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Indicates if the user is a system administrator.

workflows.name: ServiceProfileHistory Data Selection
steps: Set input parameters for service ID and session agency ID.
Fill ServiceProfileHistory object with retrieved data.

business_rules: A valid user session must be established to perform data selection.
User input parameters must include ServiceID and SessionAgencyID.
validations: Ensure UserSession is not null before data selection.
Validate UUID format for service ID and agency ID.

calculations.description: Formatting of action date into a short date format.
Concatenation of agency and name initials for display.

conditions: Check if session is valid before proceeding with data operations.
Use alternative language fields if UseAltLanguageFields is true.
system_behavior: Cancels ObjectDataSource selecting event if UserSession is null.

dependencies.description: ServiceProfileHistorySearch procedure depends on correctly setting database parameters.
User session object must be correctly initialized for data retrieval.

exceptions.description: Data retrieval is canceled when UserSession is invalid.
